label: unvalidated model projection — no sportsbook price, not a recommendation
method_note: (2026-11-03) Crawls 31 prop output files; keeps each row's best model market with p in [25%, 80%]. UNVALIDATED MODEL PROJECTIONS: no sportsbook price exists for these props, so there is no edge (the modules' 'STRONG = 10%+ vs -120' compared to an assumed price and is not used). Rows projected from the hard-coded 2024-25 table (source 'fallback') are excluded. correlated_doubles = 2+ projections in one game; confluence_triples = 3+ projections on one player (same model, not independent agreement).
